content: Piyeer na Saaŋ wirɗiɗ lafañ
Wa raakka mbeh, Piyeer na Saaŋ kaɗta kiima Kooh ŋ Kahan Kooh. Wa nikee jamanooniŋ kiimi na tumse ŋ ɓak noh soos.

Waam raak ɓooɓa ɓayeeɗa ƴaar lafñiɗ nga, a rimuk rimuk na lafñiŋ ɗe. Mbeh nu nik, a na ɓayse ɓayu, a degu ŋ sero buntaana na woyse "Buntaani-Moɗohngaani" ne a min yalwaan ŋ ɓooɓi na aase ŋ Kahan Kooh.
Wi a hot Piyeer na Saaŋ heeɗa aase, a meekissa ɓa yalwaan.
Piyeer na Saaŋ jen iiƴeeɗa ɗe, Piyeer woosa ɗe ne : « Marka ɓoo ! »
A markeeɗa ɓa baahiɗ, a ammba ne a hey rahse in nga ɓa.
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne : « Ŋ raakɗi urus ŋ raakɗi haalis, waaye ini ŋ raak, ŋ hey ɗa wa one : Ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa yiŋ Nasareet, kurka fu tiind ! »
A ammba ɗe ŋ yaah-ñaahum, a kurkiɗta ɗe, ŋ ɗiska ɗiska kot ciŋ ɗe nikka ndengiɗ tir.
A kurukka japit, a tufukka, a tiindeeɗa. A hunnda na ɓa, a aassa Kahan Kooh, a tiindeeɗa, a gongtiɗkeeɗa, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Ɓooɓa jen hotta ɗe tiindeeɗa, a gidmeeɗa Kooh.
Ɓa inhissa ɗe ne a yi meeɗ ɓoof, a yalwaanee ŋ buntaana na woyse "moɗohngaani" ŋ Kahan Kooh, weɗ ɓa jaahɗoh, ɓa feyuusa ŋ ini raak.
Woo kiŋ Piyeer
Ƴaara lafñee nikka ŋoɗiɗ ŋ Piyeer na Saaŋ, ɓooɓa jen feyuusa, ɓa faɗsukka ɗiska ɓi Piyeer nikee ŋ ɗiska na woyse Perngaŋ-Suleymaan ngaŋ Kahan Kooh.
Wa Piyeer hot ineem, a woosa mboolnda ne : « Israayel ci, wa ye tah ɗu feyuusa ŋ inii, wa ye tah ɗu markee ɓoo ? Ɗu liiɓ ne wa hatiliŋ ɓoo, wala nupi ɓoo nup Kooh tah ƴaarii wir po a tiinde e ?
Koohiŋ Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa, Koohiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo, teeɓohiɗ yaki surgaaniŋ ɗe Yeesu yak. Te e ɗu eɗoh ɗe, ɗu taasukka ɗe ŋ fiki Pilaat yi tufkee ŋ kot faɗis ɗe.
Ɗu taaskiɗ Yi hool wuu Kooh te a yurahha, ɗu kiimmba Pilaat ne, ɗu faɗsiɗu apoh ɓo'.
Ɗu apɗukiɗ Heɗ kipes ki, waaye Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe. Ɓoo nak, ɓoo miniɗ seede ineem.

Kosi ɓoo kos Yeesu, weɗ tah woo ki ɓoo woo ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe onnda ƴaari ɗu na hote yii te ɗu inahha ɗe, hatil po a minnda tufuk ndengiɗ. E tiikiŋ Yeesu, na kosi puloh nga ɗe, on ƴaari wir jameet findi ɗu hotoha an.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu tum Yeesu ineem ŋ inhaaɗi, ɗu na kilifaaciŋ ɗu.
Waaye Kooh raakiɗta ineem ne ini a woyee maañiɗ taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci jen raak, ne Mucɗohi a gapohee joyiɗ raak miskiɗ.
Mbaa ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, ɗu wiiruk ŋ Kooh ne a moos bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu.
Ŋ ineem, Heɗ ɓoo hey ɗu one ɓi jamano iɗsiɗkoha, a woosoh ɗu Mucɗohi a tanɗee ɗu maañiɗ, Yeesu.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, Eel ci joyiɗ daliɗ Yeesu po jamanooni in ci jen doknohsan as, findi Kooh woyoha maañiɗ taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ciŋ ɗe hooliɗ ci.
Laam Musaa woyeen ne : “ Heɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu, hey ɗu woosohe Woosuuɗ findiiso, a pulohan cuuɓiŋ ɗu, sikɗukaat in ci a woyan ɗu jen.
Te ɓo' nu sikɗukɗi Woosuuɗeem ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ Kooh, a apu. ”
Woosuuɗ ci woo jen, ina amboh ŋ Samuwel po ɓi taamb nga ɗe, findi ɓa hend jen, namiɗ yegɗoh mbeh ci ɓoo na pese cii.
E ɗu lam woosuuɗ ceem, ambtiɗohi Kooh tufkiɗee na caac ciŋ ɗu, wa wuu ɗu wi a woyee Ibrahiima ne : “ Ŋ hey barke'ɗe cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen taamboh ŋ ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa. ”
Kooh koc woos surgaaniŋ ɗe nga ɗu, a woosiɗ ɗe ne a barke'iɗ ɗu, a tum po yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah eɗ finho tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe moɗaaɗiici. »
